note: Which ElevenLabs voice speaks for which character. The voiceId values stay empty until the owner has listened to auditions and chosen (M4 phase H). modelId must be the exact id of the model the owner picks in ElevenLabs; it is left empty rather than guessed.
_settingsNote: Sent explicitly with every line (voice_gen refuses settings without stability and similarity_boost), so nothing depends on the settings stored with a voice in the ElevenLabs account. 0.5 and 0.75 are ElevenLabs' API defaults and the values of round 1 of the diagnostic audition (docs/audio/voice-quality-diagnosis.md); the voice-and-sound-director sets the final values after round 2. A style's settings go on top of these, key by key. style and speed are never sent to a v4 model (v4 does not use them), so on eleven_v4 and eleven_v4_turbo the cheer is stability 0.1 only.
_candidatesNote: Voices with "candidate": true are for voice_gen auditions only (the Languages voice pilot, docs/languages/voices.md): voice_gen plan and generate never use them, and no pack or character points at them. The four lang-* voices are the English and Russian course voices the owner chose himself on 2026-11-08 (idStatus owner-chosen 2026-11-08); they stay candidates until the pilot (docs/languages/voices.md section 11) has passed the isolated-sound test, then the candidate flag is dropped. An idStatus OWNER-TO-FILL would mean an empty voiceId on purpose.
_modelNote: A voice may have its own modelId (voices.<name>.modelId); the others use the modelId above. Owner's decision of 2026-11-08: nitzi is voiced on eleven_v4 and hero-son on eleven_v4_turbo (the global one).
_priceNote: USD per 1,000 characters, list API prices (PLAN.md › costs), used only for the estimate that voice_gen plan prints. The owner's plan may differ; --price replaces them.

lang-en-female.role: English course, main target voice: every English clip except the puppet's lines (docs/languages/voices.md section 11)

lang-en-male.role: English course, the puppet Pip (male): the lines of the puppet_talk activities (9 clips)

lang-ru-female.role: Russian course, main target voice: every Russian clip except the puppet's lines

lang-ru-male.role: Russian course, the puppet Саша: the lines of the puppet_talk activities (11 clips)
